ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the grant scheme and other allegations of fraud in Minnesota to determine the extent of the issue and those involved.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to uncover the truth
questions: What is the extent of the grant scheme?
Who is involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. By following the money trail, we can uncover the truth and bring transparency to the grant allocation process.
